title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Activation and the Program Year's Entitlement
content:
**Article 1 — Signature.** A program under the Demand Service Rate Programs takes effect only when the signed enrollment is on file against it.
The signature is the one recorded in the office's intake records against that program; the caller's
statement that the enrollment has been signed does not take its place.

**Article 2 — The offer's validity.** The signature must reach the office no later than the tier's quote
validity counted forward from the day the enrollment offer was issued, counting calendar days with the
day of issue excluded and the final day included; past that the enrollment is reissued at current rates.
The day the offer was issued is the enrollment date carried on the program record, and the validity in
calendar days is that program's quote validity.

*Both sides of the boundary, on a program whose validity is 30 calendar days and whose offer issued on
the boundary day.* A signature reaching the office on the 30th day after the day of issue is inside the
validity, because the final day is included. A signature reaching the office on the 31st day is outside
it, and the enrollment is reissued at current rates.

**Article 3 — Term.** The term runs for the tier's term length from the day the program takes effect.

**Article 4 — Emergency dispatches.** At the start of each program year the program is credited with the
tier's included emergency dispatches, and unused emergency dispatches are forfeited at the year end
rather than carried forward.

**Article 5 — Blocks.** A block of prepaid hours is credited only when a block is actually bought, never
at activation, because a block is a purchase and not an entitlement of the tier.

**Article 6 — Validity and term by program.** The validity in Article 2 and the term in Article 3 are
those of the program the enrollment was offered on:

| Program | Offer validity (calendar days) | Term (calendar months) |
|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 30 | 12 |
| Priority Response Program | 30 | 12 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 30 | 12 |
| Emergency Response Program | 45 | 12 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 45 | 24 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 60 | 24 |
